Booking Policy

Deposit

A $100 non-refundable booking deposit is required to secure your date. Your date is not confirmed until the deposit is received.

Balance Due

The remaining balance is due 4 to 5 days prior to your wedding or event date.

Cancellations

Cancellations more than 7 days before your event forfeit the deposit only. Cancellations within 7 days are charged the full remaining balance.

Travel

Travel fees apply to all bookings and are calculated based on distance from Bundall, time, tolls, parking and fuel. All travel costs are itemised in your personalised quote.

Minimum Booking

Mobile bookings require a minimum of 3 people. Exceptions may apply at Laura's discretion. In-salon trials are available individually.

After Hours

A surcharge of $50 per hour applies for services starting before 6:00am or finishing after 6:00pm. Included in your personalised quote.
